name: Caterwaul Sling
text:
Made of shiny brown leather, this +1 striking sling has a single white thread interwoven into its cord.

Activate—Unleash Roar 2 (manipulate, sonic)

Frequency once per day

---

Effect You pull the white thread free, then whirl the sling in circles at high speed. It lets out an ear-piercing wave of sound. Each creature in a 30-foot cone takes 4d6 sonic damage (DC 21 basic Fortitude save save). Any creature that fails is Deafened for 1 round, or 1 hour on a critical failure.
